description: The file 'tcExecute.php' is a PHP script used in the TestLink open-source test management project. It handles execution of test cases and test suites via AJAX calls, interacting with remote servers using XML-RPC. The script includes logic for initiating remote test execution, handling different levels (test case, test suite, project), and generating XML/HTML responses for display.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for custom fields, used to fetch and handle custom field data.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class managing hierarchical data structures, used here to obtain subtrees and node information.

methods.name: remote_exec_testcase
methods.description: Executes a single test case remotely via XML-RPC, returning an XML/HTML snippet with the result.

methods.name: remote_exec_testcase_set
methods.description: Executes a set of test cases under a specified parent node (e.g., test suite), returning results as XML/HTML.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments needed for request processing, including test case ID and level.
